newsitem.title: USA: OEC Medical Systems seen undervalued - report.
newsitem.headline: OEC Medical Systems seen undervalued - report.

text.p: Some shareholders think shares of OEC Medical Systems have yet to reach their full potential, according to a column in the latest issue of the weekly business magazine, Business Week.
In the March 31 issue, the column "Inside Wall Street" said holders held such beliefs even though the stock had risen to more than 16 per share on March 18 from six in early 1995.
It quoted one of them as saying the stock was undervalued, considering the company's apparent lead in the field of making computer-based medical instruments like X-ray imaging systems.
The column cited the unidentified holder as saying the stock could be worth 30 a share if a buy-out were to occur.
On Thursday, the stock closed at 16-3/4 on the New York Stock Exchange.
